unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #19 "Add Nano (XNO) as an extensible asset / payment scheme — a feeless settlement rail" on michielpost/x402-dotnet. Argued in its own design terms: the extensible AssetInfoProvider and payment schemes (exact/upto/batch-settlement) map cleanly onto Nano — feeless and instant, no gas plumbing, raw units (1e30), nano:mainnet CAIP-2; carried live Vend nano-info endpoint. https://github.com/michielpost/x402-dotnet/issues/19
